Product Generalist
SuperOps.ai
Remote or Hybrid

About the Role:
We are looking for a creative product thinker who loves shipping features and talking to customers.

Responsibilities:
• Speak with customers, gather user feedback, and craft feature roadmaps.
• Write user stories, PRD specs, and collaborate with engineering.
• Test product releases and measure feature adoption.

Requirements:
• Genuine passion for software product management and UX.
• Familiarity with Agile, Jira, wireframing, and analytics.
• No rigid college or experience prerequisites; we evaluate you solely on your skills and execution!
